title: Interactive Guided Theatre
tagline: A guided story you can step into.
shortDescription: Live actors, prerecorded media, and real props come together in a story that visitors move through and help decide, using their phones or simple remotes along the way.
longDescription: A phygital performance format in which visitors are guided through a story space. Live actors lead the way and play scenes, prerecorded video, sound, and light take over between them, and props in the room become part of the plot. At key moments the audience decides how the story continues, voting on their phones or with simple analogue remotes such as buttons, levers, or tokens, and the scenography reacts in real time. It can run as a linear route, a semi-open exploration, or a themed world, and the script, roles, media, decisions, and languages are configurable. BRDGE handles the interaction logic, scene management, and journey, leaderboard, and data links end to end.

highlights.title: Theatre Meets Technology
highlights.description: Actors bring warmth and surprise, media and effects bring scale, and together they create moments neither could achieve alone.

highlights.title: The Audience Shapes the Story
highlights.description: Decisions on phones or remotes change what happens next, so visitors feel responsible for the outcome and pay closer attention.

highlights.title: A Small Cast, Many Shows
highlights.description: Prerecorded scenes and automated cues carry parts of the performance, so a small cast can run many sessions a day at the same quality.

highlights.title: Plot Twists Built In
highlights.description: Add alternative endings based on the group's choices, a hidden character who appears only on certain paths, a puzzle that unlocks the next room, or a finale where the whole audience acts together.

highlights.title: Stages for Any Story
highlights.description: Walk through a company's history with its founders as characters, solve a murder mystery at a gala evening, follow a scientist through a museum lab, or join a festive fairy tale for families.

highlights.title: Know How the Story Lands
highlights.description: Add a data layer that records group decisions, chosen endings, session counts, and dwell time per scene, showing which moments move the audience most.

highlights.title: More Ways to Play Along
highlights.description: Pair with Remote Controllers to let visitors trigger effects from their phones, with Laser Voting for decisions as a crowd, with Spatial Mediaguide to continue the story on visitors' phones, or with Journey Recap to send each group their own ending.
